title: Rev. Stainislaus v. State of Madhya Pradesh

content.caseIdentity: Rev. Stainislaus v. State of Madhya Pradesh, (1977) 1 SCC 677
content.holding: Article 25(1) right to propagate religion does not include a fundamental right to convert another person; anti-conversion statutes prohibiting force/fraud are constitutional.
content.relevance: Benchmark ruling on religious propagation vs conversion.

evidence.note: Supreme Court of India (1977) 1 SCC 677; 1977 INSC 13; 1977 (2) SCR 611; 5-Judge Constitution Bench holding right to propagate does not include right to convert.
